scenarios.name: speech lifecycle
steps: GET /api/robot
POST /api/sessions
POST /api/speech/utterances
GET /api/operations/{operation_id}
POST /api/sessions/{session_id}/close
expected: connected fake or native-fixture
201 active session
202 accepted/running operation
succeeded within 5s in fixture
202 cleanup, then succeeded
nondeterminism: operation can complete before first GET

scenarios.name: speech options and contextual animated speech
steps: GET /api/speech/options without a session
POST a plain utterance and await completion
POST an animated utterance while awake and await completion
start an animated utterance with a fixture long enough to be interrupted
POST /api/motion/stop with scope all and read both operations
expected: supported languages, voice, ranges and animated capability for this connection
speech.utterance owns speech.output
speech.animated_utterance owns speech, locomotion, joints and lights; succeeded
running in the fixture with independent audio and motion
confirmed stop cancels the utterance; missing confirmation preserves unknown and ownership
client_decisions: Request animated speech only when the capability is available for the selected language.
Reconcile both operation results before issuing more motion after an uncertain stop.

scenarios.name: idempotency
steps: repeat identical session creation/key
repeat identical speech creation/key
change speech body with same key
expected: same session ID
same operation ID
409 idempotency_conflict

scenarios.name: stream reset
steps: create subscription
attach stream
disconnect
reattach with arbitrary Last-Event-ID
expected: stream.ready then state.sample; live touch for native fixture
stream slot detached within 3s
stream.ready, stream.reset, state.sample; no replay
nondeterminism: live events may arrive between snapshots

scenarios.name: uncertain dispatch
steps: start fixture speech
kill/freeze native agent
GET operation
explicit revoke with force_release
expected: API remains live; agent restarts
unknown; speech.output quarantined
fencing acknowledgement required; original unknown remains unknown

scenarios.name: expired session
steps: create session with short test lease
start speech
stop renewing
try mutation
expected: active
running
expired; cleanup stops or quarantines work

scenarios.name: API restart
steps: create session, subscription and operation
kill and restart API
GET old operation and renew old session
deliberately create a new session
expected: IDs belong to original bridge instance
new bridge_instance_id; empty sessions, operations, subscriptions and retry keys
404 for old IDs; earlier robot outcome remains unknown to new API
new session accepted; no old commands replayed

scenarios.name: sample recording and immutable download
steps: POST /api/recordings with samples source, groups, explicit duration and byte bound
GET /api/recordings/{recording_id} and associated operation until finalized
GET /api/assets/{asset_id}
GET /api/assets/{asset_id}/content
GET content with Range and matching If-Range
restart API with the same asset directory
expected: 201 starting recording and associated operation ID
completed or failed with explicit partial-data error
metadata includes completed/partial status, byte count and SHA-256
NDJSON metadata, samples, explicit gaps and end row; hash matches metadata
206, exact selected bytes and Content-Range
assets remain; sessions/operations/recordings do not resume; interrupted files become partial
nondeterminism: acquisition timestamps and actual sample cadence
gaps and unavailable groups are explicit, never interpolated

scenarios.name: shared sonar observers
steps: GET /api/sensors and cached sensors state without a session
create two session-owned POST /api/sensors/observers with sources [sonar]
GET both observers until active
read sensors state and per-reading quality
POST first observer stop and reconcile
read remaining observer and state
POST remaining observer stop and reconcile
read state immediately after stopping
expected: sonar discovered but not activated; values null
201 starting resources sharing one native subscription
warming then active within 5s in software fixture
left 0.4m measured, right 1.2m estimated; acquisition window retained
first stopped; remaining observer active
remaining observer still receives fresh readings
stopped after native own-name unsubscribe confirmation
sonar values null; no old cached distances presented as active
nondeterminism: active is producer state, not a guarantee that an individual reading is valid

scenarios.name: motion freshness and odometry origin after agent recovery
steps: GET /api/state?include=motion&wait_for_fresh_ms=1000
GET /api/state?include=motion,sensors&max_age_ms=0
terminate or freeze the fixture agent and await a new connected generation
read fresh motion state again
expected: motion group is fresh and contains an odometry origin ID
both groups are stale with reason sample_too_old
connection_generation increases
fresh odometry reports a new origin_id
client_decisions: Refuse a move while required observations are stale or unavailable.
Reset or explicitly relocalize the map after an origin change.
Resume observation after reconnect and require a deliberate drive command.

scenarios.name: finite walking and planar odometry
steps: read fresh motion state and retain odometry origin
submit bounded displacement with omitted speed
await operation and read fresh odometry
submit another move and wait for locomotion_active
cancel the operation and reconcile current motion state
expected: motion state names position and velocity frames
202 owns locomotion and all discovered joints and uses default speed fraction
fixture odometry moves by the requested displacement within the same origin
active locomotion is observed
cancelled after native inactive and the move call ends
nondeterminism: opaque origin and operation IDs, acquisition timestamps, float precision
physical stop and odometry accuracy are separate acceptance gates

scenarios.name: scoped motion stop across sessions
steps: start speech and a finite move as one session
submit POST /api/motion/stop with {} as a second session
check move and speech outcomes
start a joint move and submit POST /api/motion/stop with scope all
expected: the locomotion stop confirms native inactivity
finite move is cancelled and speech continues
the all-motion stop confirms walking and joint stop and cancels the joint move
an unconfirmed native result yields unknown with unresolved IDs and keeps ownership
nondeterminism: opaque operation IDs and timing of native completion

scenarios.name: battery and sonar threshold crossings
steps: subscribe with a battery below rule and a sonar below rule
attach SSE with fresh battery above the exit threshold
feed battery exactly at enter, inside band, and exactly at exit
check inactive sonar until a separate observer starts it
feed valid sonar values, then a no-echo value and a valid baseline
reattach after a socket or observation gap
expected: 201 maps accepted rules to opaque IDs and declares sensor.threshold_changed
initial sensor snapshot and no synthetic crossing
two battery events with correct active flags and acquisition times
no implicit sonar activation
no false crossing due to missing echo or resumed readings
stream.reset and a new baseline with no replay
nondeterminism: opaque rule and subscription IDs, acquisition timestamps

scenarios.name: owned face observation and camera coexistence
steps: attach vision.detections before creating an observer
create two compatible observers and await activation
request a conflicting rate from a second session
capture a still while the detector is active
stop the first observer and receive detections for the second
stop the last observer and reconnect the event stream
expected: stream.ready reports inactive face observations
201 returns observer IDs and GET returns accepted camera and rate
conflicting configuration returns resource_busy
still capture produces an independent PNG asset
detection geometry includes observer ID, camera frame and source timestamp
last observer reaches stopped and no observations are replayed
nondeterminism: opaque IDs, native image timestamps, and callback ordering

scenarios.name: light transitions and read-back
steps: GET /api/lights and compare the eyes and eyes.left resource lists
POST /api/lights/transitions for eyes.left with color #0000ff and brightness 0.5
repeat the POST with the same key, then await completion
send a color to a mono group
apply brightness to the mono group and await completion
GET /api/state?include=lights and subscribe to light samples
expected: available RGB and mono groups and overlapping eye resources
202 lights.transition
same operation ID and succeeded
422 unsupported
succeeded with mono brightness applied
the left eye reports observed blue at 0.5, the eyes group is mixed, and SSE carries the same readings
client_decisions: Use listed modes and overlapping resource IDs when choosing targets.
Read fresh actuator state independently of the operation result.

scenarios.name: owned velocity expiry and controlled stop
steps: check motion.velocity capability and fresh joint and motion state
PUT sequence zero with a complete robot-frame target
PUT a newer sequence, then repeat it
send an older sequence
leave the session live, stop sending targets and read the terminal operation
try to renew the ended control_id
expected: software fixtures advertise velocity; hardware remains gated
locomotion and body joints are reserved by one operation
the newer sequence keeps the operation ID and the duplicate keeps its expiry
the older update is rejected with stale_sequence
velocity_expired succeeds only after confirmed controlled stop
the ended ID is rejected with control_ended
client_decisions: Check the retained operation after control_ended to distinguish confirmed stop from unknown.
If the stop outcome is unknown, recover explicitly before issuing more motion.
nondeterminism: opaque operation ID and accepted expiry timestamp
any unconfirmed stop keeps locomotion reserved and reports unknown
